skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts of insurance business and insurance business administration, the objective necessity of insurance business administration, scientific basis and main contents of insurance business administration.
Understand the concept and characteristics of market insurance, classification of market insurance, structure of market insurance, state management of insurance business activities.

Understand the concept and classification of insurance companies, organizational models of insurance companies, main functions of insurance companies, characteristics of insurance company operations, business strategies of insurance companies.
Comprehend the general overview of insurance products, issues related to developing new insurance products, pricing and product management, quality management of insurance products.

Understand the concept and classification of distribution channels in insurance business activities, role of distribution channels, insurance agents and brokers, selection and management of distribution channels.

Apply knowledge of insurance business and insurance business administration to analyze and evaluate business operations, organizational structures, strategic planning, market analysis, policies in insurance business.
Develop independent research capabilities, synthesis, logical and critical thinking skills, teamwork skills, presentation skills, problem-solving skills, leadership skills.
Ability to plan, coordinate, manage resources, assess and improve the effectiveness of activities.
